tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Finn wants to talk about picnic plans. what food to pack. where to sit. what time to arrive.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Finn.

promptBlocks.subject: Picnic plans
paragraphs: I am writing about picnic plans. what food to pack? where to sit?
what time to arrive? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Finn and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: picnic plans
ketImageBrief.panel1: Finn starts picnic plans with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Finn solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
